inspection: Read both completed onefile CArchives and decompressed every member in memory. Validated MZ/PE headers without loading or extracting application DLLs. Compared SHA256 using full archive-relative paths; then read final Analysis-00.toc and hashed each of its 119 native source files with approved read-only access.

priorAudit.scope: Prior static direct/delay import and packaged export-symbol closure evidence is reused only because all 119 native payloads and full archive-relative paths are byte-identical. No new target-OS runtime claim is inferred from hashes.

initialCandidateEvidence.finding: Initial sandbox build omitted 38 API-set shims and transitive ucrtbase.dll due to denied file reads. Approved read-only probes confirmed all 39 system payloads matched the old EXE. The final approved build restores all 39.

limits: DLL presence and packaged-target exported symbols are checked statically. OS API-set resolution uses Windows conventions; other Windows versions and dynamic LoadLibrary paths are not runtime-tested here.
